-- Harga terbaru Beras Kualitas Medium I per provinsi, pasar tradisional
select w.nama as provinsi, h.tanggal, h.harga
from harga h
join wilayah w using (wilayah_sk)
join komoditas k using (komoditas_id)
where k.nama_komoditas = 'Beras Kualitas Medium I'
  and h.jenis_pasar_id = 1
  and w.level_wilayah = 'provinsi'
  and not h.is_outlier
qualify row_number() over (partition by h.kode_wilayah order by h.tanggal desc) = 1
order by h.harga desc

-- Rata-rata bulanan Cabai Rawit Merah, nasional, pasar tradisional
select cast(date_trunc('month', tanggal) as date) as bulan,
       round(avg(harga)) as harga
from harga
where kode_wilayah = 'nasional'
  and jenis_pasar_id = 1
  and komoditas_id = 'com_16'
  and not is_outlier
group by 1
order by 1

-- Perubahan harga nasional (pasar tradisional) dibanding setahun sebelumnya
with t as (
  select komoditas_id, tanggal, harga
  from harga
  where kode_wilayah = 'nasional' and jenis_pasar_id = 1
    and level_komoditas = 2 and not is_outlier
),
akhir as (select komoditas_id, max(tanggal) as tgl from t group by 1)
select k.nama_komoditas,
       s.harga as sekarang,
       l.harga as setahun_lalu,
       round(100.0 * (s.harga - l.harga) / l.harga, 1) as perubahan_pct
from akhir a
join t s on s.komoditas_id = a.komoditas_id and s.tanggal = a.tgl
asof join t l on l.komoditas_id = a.komoditas_id and l.tanggal <= a.tgl - 365
join komoditas k on k.komoditas_id = a.komoditas_id
order by perubahan_pct desc

-- Harga nasional terbaru per mata rantai dan selisih produsen -> pasar tradisional
with terbaru as (
  select *
  from harga
  where kode_wilayah = 'nasional' and level_komoditas = 2 and not is_outlier
  qualify row_number() over (partition by jenis_pasar_id, komoditas_id order by tanggal desc) = 1
)
select k.nama_komoditas,
       max(harga) filter (where jenis_pasar_id = 4) as produsen,
       max(harga) filter (where jenis_pasar_id = 3) as pedagang_besar,
       max(harga) filter (where jenis_pasar_id = 1) as pasar_tradisional,
       round(100.0 * (pasar_tradisional - produsen) / produsen, 1) as selisih_pct
from terbaru
join komoditas k using (komoditas_id)
group by k.nama_komoditas, k.urutan
order by selisih_pct desc nulls last

-- Nilai yang ditandai is_outlier (menyimpang > 3x median 11 hari pasar sekitarnya)
select h.tanggal, w.nama as wilayah, p.nama_jenis_pasar as pasar,
       k.nama_komoditas, h.harga, h.harga_median_sekitar
from harga h
join wilayah w using (wilayah_sk)
join komoditas k using (komoditas_id)
join pasar p using (jenis_pasar_id)
where h.is_outlier
order by h.tanggal desc

-- Banyaknya sel harga per tahun dan jenis pasar
select tahun, p.nama_jenis_pasar as pasar, count(*) as sel_harga
from harga
join pasar p using (jenis_pasar_id)
group by all
order by tahun, pasar
